import smtplib
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from email.message import EmailMessage
from agents import function_tool
from portal_client import portal
SMTP_HOST = 'smtp.internal.example.com'
SENDER = 'recruiting-noreply@example.com'
PACKET_BUILD_SCRIPT = '/opt/recruiting/bin/build_interview_packet'


def _build_interview_packet(candidate_id: int) -> bool:
    # Regenerate the candidate's interview packet so the guest sees current materials.
    result = subprocess.run(
        [PACKET_BUILD_SCRIPT, '--candidate-id', str(candidate_id)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    return result.returncode == 0


@function_tool
def invite_external_interviewer(interviewer_email: str, candidate_id: int, valid_days: int=7) -> dict:
    expires_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=valid_days)
    packet_built = _build_interview_packet(candidate_id)
    grant = portal.guest_access.create(email=interviewer_email, scope=f'candidate:{candidate_id}:interview_packet', role='guest_interviewer', expires_at=expires_at.isoformat())
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = SENDER
    msg['To'] = interviewer_email
    msg['Subject'] = 'Your interview panel access'
    msg.set_content(f"You have been invited to review an interview packet.\n\nSign in here: {grant['login_url']}\nThis link expires on {expires_at:%Y-%m-%d}.")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    return {'grant_id': grant['id'], 'interviewer_email': interviewer_email, 'candidate_id': candidate_id, 'expires_at': expires_at.isoformat(), 'email_sent': True, 'packet_built': packet_built}
